avatarUrl.title: Avatar image address
avatarUrl.description: The web address (https) of the picture shown for your bot. Empty: your website's icon (set in the Portal under Website settings › Brand and look), else the first letter of the bot's name.

launcherPosition.title: Launcher position
launcherPosition.description: Which bottom corner of the page the chat button sits in.

launcherStyle.title: Launcher style
launcherStyle.description: Round: a round button. Label: a button with the launcher text.

hideOnPages.title: Hide on pages
hideOnPages.description: Pages where the chat is hidden: paths starting with /, where * stands for any characters in one part and ** for any number of parts (for example /checkout/**).

windowStyle.title: Window style
windowStyle.description: Floating: a window above the page. Side panel: a panel along the side of the page.

fullScreenOnMobile.title: Full screen on phones
fullScreenOnMobile.description: On phones the chat fills the whole screen when it is open.

showTimes.title: Show times and day dividers
showTimes.description: Shows the time of each message and a divider between days.

showPaused.title: Tell visitors while the team reviews
showPaused.description: While staff paused the AI, the visitor sees the paused notice (Texts).

allowGuests.title: Allow guests to chat
allowGuests.description: Visitors can chat without signing in, up to the guest message limit, remembered on their device.

contactCapture.title: Ask guests for contact details
contactCapture.description: Never: guests are not asked. Before first: before the first message. On handoff: when the chat is handed to a person.

allowSignedIn.title: Allow signed-in visitors to chat
allowSignedIn.description: Visitors signed in with Accounts chat as themselves; a guest chat moves to the account on sign-in.

claimByPhone.title: Move guest chats by phone
claimByPhone.description: On sign-in, guest chats whose captured phone equals the verified phone move to the account too.

showTyping.title: Show typing while the AI prepares a reply

visitorUploads.title: Visitors may attach
visitorUploads.description: Staff can always attach. Which file types visitors may send, and how large each may be, is your list of upload types.

ratingKind.title: Rating kind
ratingKind.description: csat: the visitor picks one of your labels (satisfaction). nps: How likely are you to recommend us, from 0 to 10.

ratingLabels.title: Labels, lowest first
ratingLabels.description: For csat: one label per point, from the lowest to the highest, 2 to 10 of them.

ratingAskWhen.title: Ask for a rating
ratingAskWhen.description: On resolve: when the chat is resolved. After staff: only when a person took part. Manual: only when staff ask.

emailTranscripts.title: Allow email transcripts
emailTranscripts.description: Visitors and staff can email a copy of the chat transcript.

proactiveIdleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before the nudge
proactiveIdleMinutes.description: 0 = no idle nudge. Idle minutes before showing a nudge to visitors.

proactiveOncePer.title: Show the nudge once per
proactiveOncePer.description: Session: once per visit. Product: once for each product the visitor looks at.

proactiveExit.title: Exit intent nudge on desktop
proactiveExit.description: Nudges visitors when their cursor leaves the window at the top.
